Hi Jasmine,

I’m leading the security due diligence for Nimbus Analytics as part of a procurement review. Can you please share your latest SOC 2 Type II report and any bridge letter or attestation that would cover the audit window? Our preferred audit period is Oct 1, 2024 – Sep 30, 2025. If your current report does not fully cover that window, a bridge letter describing changes and control continuity would be helpful.

Additional asks:
- A cover note confirming whether the report includes subservice provider carve-outs (if any).
- Auditor contact info (firm + engagement manager) for verification.
- Any supporting artifacts you can reasonably provide (AOC, system descriptions, PI/PII handling notes).
- Preferred secure transfer method (SFTP presigned URL or enterprise SharePoint).

We aim to complete our review by Sep 30. Could you confirm what’s available and how soon you can share? I’ve attached a short inventory template for asset mapping (nimbus-asset-request.xlsx).

Thanks,
